carousel_distinctions.why_not_search_cover: This is a fragrance-focused editorial scene: the bottle is tilted over satin and surrounded by white gardenia flowers, while the headline emphasizes '精致香氛' and '浮光栀子香'. It lacks the cover's dominant whitening-benefit claim, capacity callout, and broad summary of the product's main selling points.

This is an ingredient-and-texture detail page. A hand holds the bottle, molecular-style gold spheres decorate the background, and a large circular magnified inset shows white lotion spread on skin. The composition specifically explains the '烟酰胺·色淡林精华配方' rather than presenting a complete listing-level product summary.

This is an in-use demonstration page. A model dominates the frame and actively pumps a long stream of lotion onto her forearm; the bottle is angled and partly secondary to the application action. The visible copy focuses on gardenia fragrance, with no capacity block or complete cover-level benefit hierarchy.

This is a formula/texture feature page. The right half is occupied by an oversized sculpted lotion swirl and a translucent golden ingredient sphere, paired with the headline '烟酰胺·色淡林精华配方'. It visually prioritizes cream texture and actives rather than the product's overall listing proposition, and it omits the product-name header, whitening-timescale claim, and size.

This page is intended as a capacity-specific detail because nearly all supporting copy is reduced to one oversized boxed '260g 大容量' callout beside a clean bottle packshot; it omits the explicit product-name header, '7天美白' promise, and formula summary shown on page 0. However, its centered isolated packshot, sparse neutral background, high legibility, and prominent size claim are also conventional search-thumbnail signals, so it could plausibly be confused with a search cover.

search_identification_evidence: Page 0 is the strongest search-listing cover because it combines a large, unobstructed OLAY pump-bottle packshot with a complete top-level sales hierarchy: the product name at upper left, the dominant benefit claim '7天美白', the ingredient/formula line '烟酰胺·色淡林精华配方', and a boxed '260g 大容量' specification. The foreground arm and visible dollop also communicate body-lotion use and texture in the same frame. This gives a shopper the product identity, principal promise, formula cue, size, package appearance, and usage category at thumbnail level.
